About Meridian Prime Partners

Meridian Prime Partners is a SEBI-registered Category I and II Alternative Investment Fund Manager headquartered in Mumbai, with offices in Delhi, Bengaluru, and Singapore. Founded in 2006 by former sovereign wealth fund executives, the firm has built a reputation for rigorous underwriting discipline and long-term value creation across infrastructure, private equity, and structured credit.

The firm manages capital on behalf of pension funds, family offices, insurance companies, endowments, and high-net-worth individuals who demand institutional-grade transparency and governance. Its investment committee comprises veterans from global bulge-bracket institutions with an aggregate of over 120 years of alternative investment experience.

Meridian Prime Partners is a registered member of the Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association (IVCA) and maintains ISAE 3000-compliant reporting standards across all managed vehicles.
